name: Anthony D'Esposito

source.title: File:Anthony D’Esposito Labor portrait.jpg — Wikimedia Commons

current_role: Inspector General, U.S. Department of Labor (since January 2026)
summary: Anthony D’Esposito, a former New York City police detective and Republican congressman from Long Island (2023–2025), was confirmed as the Labor Department’s inspector general on December 18, 2025, and sworn in on January 5, 2026. His office investigated the misconduct allegations that preceded Lori Chavez-DeRemer’s resignation, and in March 2026 he joined the administration’s anti-fraud task force led by Vice President Vance; the ethics group CREW has filed a complaint that he is not impartial.
